$note: A Semi style: the shape tokens every component reads (rounded-chip / control / card / panel, shadow-card). Every style sets the same keys; colours, type and layout stay shared. Edit, then npm run build:tokens. docs/STYLES.md describes each style.
name: Flat
description: Thin borders, no card shadows, medium radii. Dense, information-first screens: dashboards, tools, admin.

radius-chip.note: Small marks: checkboxes, inline code, count marks

radius-control.note: Buttons, inputs, selects, tiles, list rows

shadow-card.note: Resting cards: none (the border separates them)
